subject: Q3 Launch: readiness preflight, ownership confirmation, and exec consent
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@acme.com>, Procurement <procurement@zeuscloud.io>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 Launch: readiness preflight, ownership confirmation, and exec consent

Team — attaching the Q3 Launch Playbook v3 and the owner RACI. We need a short preflight this morning so we can lock the slate for the group exec sync at 4pm PT. Please review the three asks below and reply inline or with a one-line ack:

1) Confirm your OKR owners and the PRIMARY success metric (see Owner_ROLLOUT_MATRIX.xlsx). If you are handing off any part of the owner responsibilities, note the new owner and a 24–48h transition plan.
2) Call out any open gating items requiring an SLA exception (brief description + mitigation). I attached SLA_exception_request.docx for templating.
3) Confirm we can surface the final deck to Acme (customer) in tomorrow's prep — legal redlines must be cleared by EOD.

High level schedule: lock owners by 12pm PT, consolidate comments by 2pm, exec consent at 4pm PT, customer readout Tuesday 9am PT.

Attachments: Q3_launch_playbook_v3.pdf (playbook), Owner_ROLLOUT_MATRIX.xlsx (owners + metrics), SLA_exception_request.docx (if needed)

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 Launch: readiness preflight, ownership confirmation, and exec consent

Kim — quick confirmation from Product launch POV:
- Primary owner: Logan Wright (product) — metric: p50 latency under 120ms for the hosted API path (samples in playbook).
- I’m handing off rollout automation to Neha for the first-week ramp (Neha -> please confirm handoff plan).
- No SLA exceptions from infra; we will need one for the customer-specific dedicated pool retention window (see playbook section 4). I’ll fill the SLA_exception_request.docx by 11:30am.

I’ll also add a short risk note about early quantization regressions in the playbook (will share before consolidation).

— Logan

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 Launch: readiness preflight, ownership confirmation, and exec consent

Logan — confirmed. Handoff OK. Transition plan (short):
- Today 11:45–12:15 PT: sync with Logan, walkthrough automation triggers and runbooks.
- Today 12:30–13:30 PT: pair with ops to run a dry-run of the rollout pipeline in staging.
- Deliverable: checklist + runbook linked in playbook (I’ll drop the URL by 1pm).

No blockers from my side. I’ll also validate the metric reporting pipeline for the p50 latency dashboard.

Neha
Neha Kapoor, Senior PM

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 Launch: readiness preflight, ownership confirmation, and exec consent

Team — from CS/renewals perspective:
- Primary owner: Marissa Cole (CS) — metric: Net Revenue Retention impact measured by expansion calls post-launch.
- We need legal to clear the customer-facing slide that outlines data retention specifics — Acme asked for 90-day KV cache retention in dedicated environment; that triggers a data handling review.
- Action: Sarah Lopez (Acme) is copied — Sarah, can you confirm your exact retention requirement? If it’s 90 days we’ll route to Security + Legal for signoff; otherwise we can probably keep it to 30 days.

I’ll collect the customer success sequence and add to the playbook by 2pm.

— Marissa

From: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 12:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 Launch: readiness preflight, ownership confirmation, and exec consent

Marissa — thanks. Confirming Acme requests 90-day retention for the dedicated KV cache for auditability purposes. We understand this may require extra review. Please let us know what evidence or compensating controls you need.

Sarah Lopez
Head of Data & Analytics, Acme Retail

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 Launch: readiness preflight, ownership confirmation, and exec consent

Adding Security note: 90-day KV cache for a customer-dedicated pool is a non-standard retention. Immediate asks:
- We need a formal SLA exception (SLA_exception_request.docx) completed with justification + compensating controls.
- Encryption-at-rest and KMS separation are mandatory — include key policy and rotation schedule.
- Temporary mitigation: we can implement an access-auditing window and stricter role separation while Legal reviews.

I’ll review the SLA doc and add security controls by 3:30pm. If Legal needs sample logs for Acme, we can produce a sanitized log set.

— Rishi
Head of Security

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 Launch: readiness preflight, ownership confirmation, and exec consent

Thanks all — I’ve reviewed the consolidated playbook and the ownership matrix. Executive consent: APPROVED with two items to close before the customer readout tomorrow:

1) Rishi: finalize the SLA_exception_request.docx and include the compensating controls & key policy.
2) Marissa/Logan: update the customer slide to clarify auditability scope (what we retain, who can access it, and the retention TTL).

Kim — please confirm you’ll surface the updated slides + the signed SLA doc in the exec packet at 3:30pm so I can sign off before the 4pm sync.

If those items are in flight I’m comfortable giving the green light for the launch slate. Good work getting this pulled together quickly.

Laura Bennett
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
